svg.title: Throughput per workload: Eski, Redis, Valkey and Dragonfly
svg.desc: Small multiples, one panel per workload with its own scale. Bars are medians of the valid repetitions, whiskers the observed minimum and maximum, hollow circles excluded repetitions.
svg.text: Throughput, median of valid repetitions with observed range
operations per second, higher is better; each panel has its own scale
Intel(R) Xeon(R) E-2288G CPU @ 3.70GHz | server CPU 1, client CPUs 2,3,4,5 | 100,000 keys | 32 connections | 60 s timed after 10 s warmup
